image_description: A close-up portrait of a mature male orangutan (Pongo pygmaeus) facing forward. The subject features characteristic long, shaggy reddish-brown fur and prominent facial cheek pads (flanges). The face is dark-skinned with small, deep-set eyes. The orangutan's hands are raised near its mouth/chin area, partially obscuring the lower face. In the bottom-left foreground, there is a distinct, sharp white geometric web-like structure that appears superimposed or floating, contrasting with the organic textures of the animal.
